payload.content: When the question filters on a COUNT or other aggregate ('with more than N rooms', 'at least 3 makers', 'having at least K likes'), use GROUP BY + HAVING — never put aggregate filters in WHERE. Pattern: SELECT key FROM t GROUP BY key HAVING COUNT(*) > N. Counts that filter on the *count itself* require GROUP BY on the entity being counted-per.

rationale: Targets spider q_asks_comparison=yes failures (35% fail rate, esp. comparison-on-aggregate questions). Pattern: model uses WHERE clauses on COUNT(*) which is invalid SQL or returns wrong row sets. Predicate: regex r'\b(more than|fewer than|at least|at most|with \d+|having \d+) (\d+|a |any |many )' AND has_aggregation.
